scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: In F2[Q8], for r=3 and r=4 arbitrary dirty scalar roles, classify whether any diagonal target (g1,g2,g3,1,...,1), with g1,g2,g3 all nonidentity and positive {i,j}-word-length profile a permutation of (2,1,1), is realizable in at most 3 paid rank-one factors D_N(g), g in {i,j}; compare with the exact 4-call direct construction. Q8 has i^2=j^2=-1 and ij=-ji. The complete endpoint set has 36 triples. Exact coefficient search finds none at depth <=3 for either role count, so the local minimum is 4 in these two models.
scope_change_reason: The selector allows a specified nonabelian operation family. Refine it to Q8 and a fully enumerated mixed target family rather than repeat PR #1822’s two-role repeated central-commutator target. After the complete r=3 census found no three-call construction, make one evidence-driven pivot to r=4 by adding exactly one arbitrary dirty identity-target role. The target tuple and call threshold remain fixed.
bottleneck_link: A 3-call realization would reduce the local paid rank-one bit-call count from 4 to 3 for a mixed nonabelian target tuple. The result is a formal group-algebra mechanism or obstruction only; the selected bit supplier remains nonbinding, so no selected kappa change follows.
stop_rule: Enumerate exact reachability through length 3 for all 36 target tuples at r=3 and with one extra dirty role at r=4, over every rank-one idempotent and both paid labels. Stop after these two finite domains; no group or role-count generalization.
evidence: For the 24 k/-k tuples, Q8 abelianization gives first-order coefficient matrix ranks rank_x=1+n_i and rank_y=1+n_j, where n_i+n_j=2; the rank bounds sum to four, so at least four paid calls are needed for every finite r>=3. For the other 12 (-1) tuples this invariant is weaker; exact coefficient search finds no word through depth 3 at r=3 or r=4. Search counts: r=3 has 56 factors, 56/2,324 depth-1/2 states, 130,144 depth-3 transitions; r=4 has 240 factors, 240/41,800 depth-1/2 states, 10,032,000 depth-3 transitions. All 36 direct four-call words replay exactly. Full-convolution update cross-checks, a two-call positive control, dropped-call and wrong-target controls pass.
